classification: nondimensional classical mixed Model-B(psi)/Model-A(Phi) gradient-flow surrogate; no fundamental, MFE, geometry, quantum, or real-world matter claim

model.flows: partial_t psi=M_psi Delta mu_psi; partial_t Phi=-M_Phi mu_Phi

coercivity.derivation: For mean(psi)=0, write P=Phi^2 and P'=P-mean(P). Minimizing 1/2<psi,L_psi psi>-eta<P',psi> over nonzero modes gives -eta^2/2<P',L_psi^-1P'>= -eta^2/4||P'||_2^2>=-eta^2/4 integral Phi^4, since L_psi=-Delta+1 has smallest nonzero eigenvalue 2 and ||P'||<=||P||.
coercivity.sufficient_condition: lambda_Phi>eta^2, yielding quartic coefficient at least (lambda_Phi-eta^2)/4 after eliminating psi; lower-order double-well terms do not defeat coercivity.
coercivity.distinctions: Continuum coercivity is mathematical. Numerical boundedness requires the listed audits/refinement. |field|<=1e6 is only a catastrophic-overflow guard, never a physical bound.

fourier.dynamic_band: max(|kx|,|ky|)<=K_N=N/2-1; original-grid Nyquist lines kx=-N/2 or ky=-N/2 are zero and never evolve
fourier.derivatives: first-derivative multiplier is i*k on dynamic modes and zero on prohibited Nyquist lines; gradient energy uses (kx^2+ky^2)|fhat|^2 on exactly the same dynamic modes
fourier.hermitian: fhat[-k]=conjugate(fhat[k]); only k=(0,0) is self-conjugate within the dynamic band, and it is real.

padded_products.method: Every quadratic and cubic nonlinear product uses the same 2N x 2N path. Embed N-grid dynamic coefficients unchanged at matching physical signed modes in a zero 2N array; inverse-transform with the 2N inverse convention; multiply in physical space; forward-transform with (2N)^-2 normalization; then restrict coefficients to the N-grid dynamic band. No rescaling beyond the declared transform normalization is applied.
padded_products.nyquist: Set original-grid Nyquist lines to zero before embedding and after every accepted step.

diagnostics.nonlinear_truncation_fraction: For each padded nonlinear product, sum spectral energy outside the N dynamic band before restriction divided by all padded-product spectral energy; hard limit 0.10.
diagnostics.near_cutoff_fraction: For each resolved state, energy in 0.8*K_N<=max(|kx|,|ky|)<=K_N divided by dynamic-band energy; hard limit 0.02.
diagnostics.refinement: Both diagnostics must be reported for N=32,64,128 and non-increasing from 64 to 128 within a 1e-12 absolute floor.

padded_products.failure: Insufficient resolution/aliasing control; terminate INCONCLUSIVE rather than infer a coupling effect.

initial_conditions.rng: Philox4x32-10. key=(low32(seed), high32(seed) XOR field_tag); counter=(zigzag32(kx),zigzag32(ky),component,stream_tag), where zigzag32(k)=2k for k>=0 and -2k-1 for k<0.
initial_conditions.modes: For 0<sqrt(kx^2+ky^2)<=4 choose the representative whose tuple (ky,kx) is lexicographically positive; draw g1,g2 from the fixed Philox-to-normal mapping and set z_k=(g1+i*g2)/sqrt(2), z_-k=conjugate(z_k). Zero mode is fixed to zero. Since N>=32, no other self-conjugate populated mode exists.
initial_conditions.fields: Use separate field tags for psi and Phi. Each has zero mean, Hermitian coefficients, and physical-space RMS 0.05 calculated once using the locked modal Parseval convention. Store/hash the ordered signed-mode coefficient table, generator manifest, and each C-order float64 physical array.
initial_conditions.cross_resolution: The same continuum coefficient table is retained at N=32/64/128; missing fine modes are zero, never independently drawn.

imex.kind: proposed simultaneous first-order IMEX; convergence must be measured and energy stability is not claimed
imex.old_state_rule: All padded nonlinear products on both right-hand sides use (psi^n,Phi^n) before either field is updated.
imex.post_step: Enforce psi k=0 exactly to its initial coefficient; zero prohibited Nyquist coefficients; restore Hermitian symmetry solely as a roundoff correction. Record relative spectral correction norm and hard-fail if >1e-13.

A.name: eta_zero_psi_decay
A.rule: At eta=0, psi_hat_k(t)=psi_hat_k(0) exp[-M_psi|k|^2(kappa_psi|k|^2+m_psi^2)t] for every dynamic mode.
A.requirement: L2 field error and modal max error each <=0.02 at finest dt, with measured dt refinement from dt/2 to dt/4 <=0.02.

B.name: forced_manufactured_coupled
B.forcing: In oracle-only equations partial_t psi=Delta mu_psi+f_psi and partial_t Phi=-mu_Phi+f_Phi, use f_psi=5*psi_ex+eta*Delta(Phi_ex^2), and f_Phi=lambda_Phi*Phi_ex*(Phi_ex^2-v_Phi^2)-2*eta*Phi_ex*psi_ex.
B.requirement: At N=32,64,128 and dt hierarchy, trajectory and final-state relative L2 errors for both fields show 64-to-128 <=0.05, 32-to-64 <=0.15, and finest temporal <=0.02.
B.boundary: Forcing is absent from every CP10 evaluation arm.

production.usable_only_if: calibration C1/C2 validates this resolution against N=128 and dt=0.000625; otherwise terminate INCONCLUSIVE without promoting a finer held-out resolution.

arms: one_way: Phi sees eta=0 psi while psi has no Phi feedback
arms_and_hypotheses.phase_randomization: For each nonzero representative psi mode, retain amplitude and replace phase by theta=2pi*u from separate Philox stream_tag=0x50484153; set the conjugate phase at -k, retain zero mode, reuse this one hashed phase table for its matched control arm. This is phase randomization, not permutation.
arms_and_hypotheses.endpoints: At fixed 0.05 cadence use trapezoid time weights and dx^2 spatial weights: E_psi=||psi_full-psi_eta0||traj/max(||psi_eta0||traj,1e-12); E_Phi analogously; E_feedback,Phi=||Phi_full-Phi_oneway||traj/max(||Phi_oneway||traj,1e-12).
arms_and_hypotheses.H1: E_psi and E_Phi full coupling each exceed their eta=0 numerical floors with paired 95% bootstrap lower endpoint >delta=max(0.01,3*max(spatial_error,temporal_error)).
arms_and_hypotheses.H2: E_feedback,Phi lower CI exceeds delta. For psi, full-vs-one-way equals full-vs-eta0 by construction and is reported as that identity, not independent evidence.
arms_and_hypotheses.H3: q=Phi^2-spatial_mean(Phi^2); A=integral_time_space psi*q/sqrt(integral psi^2 * integral q^2). Paired 95% CI of A_full-A_phase_control must exclude zero with lower endpoint >0.
arms_and_hypotheses.H4: psi one-way versus eta0 trajectory practical equivalence CI lies wholly inside [-delta,+delta].
arms_and_hypotheses.sign_reversal: Descriptive/mechanistic only; cannot independently pass or fail the primary gate.

seeds.meaning: random initial-condition ensemble, not physical subjects

statistics.bootstrap: paired complete seed records, 10000 Philox resamples seed=20260825, np.quantile(samples,[0.025,0.975],method='linear'); recompute ratio endpoints in each replicate and hash the index manifest. Held-out n=16 cannot increase after viewing outcomes; a wide CI is predeclared INCONCLUSIVE.

condition_generation.deduplication: Generate canonical JSON tuples, SHA-256 each canonical tuple, reuse identical hashes, and fail generation if two distinct tuples share an ID.

B.rule: 8 calibration seeds x [eta0,full,one_way,phase] x N64 x dt.00125

C1.rule: 8 seeds x [eta0,full] x N32,N64,N128 x dt.000625

D.rule: 8 seeds x four tuples: (lambda=.5,eta=.1),(lambda=2,eta=.1),(v=.5,eta=.1),(eta=-.1), all N64 dt.00125

E.rule: 16 held-out seeds x [eta0,full,one_way,phase] x N64 dt.00125

replay.rule: held-out seeds 1001,1008,1016 x four E arms, same production tuple

convergence_and_energy.common_band: max(|kx|,|ky|)<=N_coarse/2-1; restrict fine spectra before field comparisons
convergence_and_energy.quantities: full psi/Phi trajectories at common modes, final fields, E_psi/E_Phi/E_feedback,Phi, free-energy trajectory, nonlinear diagnostics
convergence_and_energy.energy: D_num=sum every accepted dt[M_psi integral|grad mu_psi|^2+M_Phi integral mu_Phi^2]; R_E=abs(F(T)-F(0)+D_num)/max(abs(F(T)-F(0)),D_num,max(1,abs(F(0)),abs(F(T)))); report and require R_E non-increasing under dt refinement, median<=1e-3 and 95th percentile<=1e-2.

eventual_claim: Only if all frozen checks pass: a bounded numerical claim about this nondimensional classical system and its declared environment/arms. CP11, geometry, covariance, Liouville, CFT, BCJ, consciousness, quantum advantage, and real-world matter claims remain gated.
